classification.rationale: Pyridine (CAS 110-86-1) is a separate chemically defined heterocyclic compound whose only hetero-atom is nitrogen, so it belongs in heading 2933 under chapter 29 note 1(a). Subheading 2933.31 names pyridine and its salts, which settles the code at GRI 1 and GRI 6. No ruling on pyridine itself came up in the search: the rulings found concern pyridine derivatives in 2933.39, which confirms that only the parent compound goes in 2933.31. Country of origin (China) affects Chapter 99 additional duties, not the classification.
